credits: (IGCS shared UE5 pool, raptoravis UUU 5.8.11 catalog; no per-game keys, shared pool only)
notes: Tekken 8 has no per-game AOB overrides in the catalog -- the binary id 'Polaris' is detected but raptoravis's UUU 5.8.11 registers zero specific keys, so it relies on the shared UE5 pool. Camera intercept comes from AOB_CAMERA_STRUCT_INTERCEPT1. Steam build ships with online anti-tamper -- only inject in offline / training mode.

intercepts.description: AOB_CAMERA_STRUCT_INTERCEPT1 (shared UE5 pool, SSE variant) -- field-by-field MOV block.

capture._capture_note: UE5 reversed-Z. Tight arena stages with bounded depth -> linear is fine.

camera_write_profile._comment: Standard UE5 FMinimalViewInfo at rdx. Location FVector3d (3 doubles) at 0x00, Rotation FRotator (3 floats) at 0x18, FOV at 0x24.
